feedback.problem: Find $a\cdot (b\times c)$ given that $a=⟨-1,1,0⟩$ and $b\times c=⟨6,1,7⟩.$
feedback.worked_solution:
Substituting given vectors into the formula for the scalar triple product, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot (b\times c) & =⟨-1,1,0⟩\cdot ⟨6,1,7⟩ \\  & =(-1)\cdot 6+1\cdot 1+0\cdot 7 \\  & =-5.\end{aligned}
$$
